in_marathi.name: Call
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Voice of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Call हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'kara', meaning 'to do'. In Hindu mythology, 'Call' is the voice of God that guides and inspires. It is a powerful name that symbolizes divine communication and spiritual growth.
